{{nihongo|'''Hayabusa Shrine'''|隼神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[the Imperial Palace]].

'''Hayabusa Shrine''' (隼神社) is located within the Nagi Shrine grounds and is an ancient {{ill|Shikinaisha|ja|式内社|lt=Shikinaisha}}.
[[File:隼神社.jpg|thumb|200px|right|Hayabusa Shrine stone pillar]]

=== Enshrined Deities ===
; Main deity
* {{ill|Takemikazuchi-no-Mikoto|ja|建甕槌神}}
; Additional deity
* {{ill|Futsunushi|en|Futsunushi|qid=Q1107286|qid=Q1107286|lt=Futsunushi}}

=== History ===
The exact origins of the shrine are unknown, but it is mentioned in the {{ill|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|en|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|qid=Q1052981|lt=Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku}} (860–874) as "After-In Hayabusa Shrine," ascending to the Rank of {{ill|Jūshi-i Jō|ja|従四位上|lt=Junior Fourth Rank, Upper Grade}}.<ref>{{Harvid|隼社（平凡社）|1979th year }}</ref> It is listed as a major shrine in the {{ill|Engishiki|en|Engishiki|qid=Q1342448|lt=Engishiki}} (927), where it received offerings during the {{ill|Tsukinami-no-Matsuri|ja|月次祭}} and {{ill|Niiname-no-Matsuri|en|Niiname-no-Matsuri|qid=Q11501518|lt=Niinamesai}}.<ref>{{Harvid|隼社（平凡社）|1979th year }}</ref>

Originally located in the Suzaku-in area, it was later moved to its current location in the Nagi Shrine grounds in 1918.<ref group="note">The shrine explanation panel states 1918, while other sources mention 1920.</ref>
